errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Community not found or not readable.

status.description: open, pending-application (passed, waiting out the timelock), objection-override (held by objections and under re-review; the electorate is voting against overrideQuorum), objected (held, and final because the community set objectionReview to none), approved (applied), rejected, or expired.

applyAt.description: End of the objection window; the earliest instant the approved change is applied. Present while status is pending-application, objection-override or objected.

appliedAt.description: When the approved change was actually applied.

objections.description: Non-authoritative read cache of the countable objections holding this application. The authoritative set is the objector-signed net.openfederation.governance.objection records.

votesFor.description: Non-authoritative read cache of voters who voted for. The authoritative tally is the set of voter-signed vote records.

votesAgainst.description: Non-authoritative read cache of voters who voted against.

evidenceModel.description: Set to 'vote-records' when this proposal's outcome is decided from voter-signed vote records. Absent on proposals created before that model.

cidChain.description: Lineage of proposal record CIDs a vote record may cite.

decision.description: The net.openfederation.governance.decision record this proposal was resolved by. Present only on resolved evidence-model proposals.

objectionCount.description: Countable objections currently standing against this proposal's application. Present only while at least one is standing. Counted from the objectors' signed records, so an objection below the threshold is visible before it takes effect.

objectionThreshold.description: How many countable objections hold the application. Reported alongside objectionCount so a reader can see a hold forming.

overrideQuorum.description: Votes FOR the override round must reach for the held change to apply. Frozen when the round opened, so it cannot be moved by later membership or settings changes. Present while status is objection-override.

overrideExpiresAt.description: When the override round stops accepting votes. Expiring short of overrideQuorum rejects the proposal. Present while status is objection-override.

overrideElectorate.description: Members holding community.governance.write when the round opened, which the default overrideQuorum is two-thirds of. Present while status is objection-override.

overrideOpenedAt.description: When the override round opened. Also the epoch for its tally: votes cast before it belong to the round that was objected to and do not count towards overrideQuorum.

overrideOutcome.description: How the override round ended: 'carried' (the bar was reached and the change applied) or 'expired' (the round ran out of time short of it, so the objection stands and the proposal is rejected).
